name: volcano

checks.requirement: The volcano is shown cut in half as a cross-section
checks.evidence: The volcano’s front is cut away to reveal its internal layers and passageways.

checks.requirement: A magma chamber is shown below the volcano
checks.evidence: A large orange magma chamber is visible beneath the volcano and labeled as such.

checks.requirement: A vent connects the magma chamber to the top
checks.evidence: A central vertical passage connects the magma chamber to the summit.

checks.requirement: Lava is shown coming out of the volcano
checks.evidence: Red lava is visible at the summit and flowing down the right side.
